visual_brief.subject: ChatGPT Ads expands conversion integrations ahead of a visual pilot
verified_context: On October 5, OpenAI announced expanded ChatGPT Ads conversion integrations and measurement partnerships.
Its visual ad test is planned for later October in the US; the announcement describes incrementality work as early-stage.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Separate attributed conversions from causal lift and review conversion-data governance before connecting customer systems.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A small terracotta specimen rests on a pale sculptural platform, separated by an open gap from a second charcoal platform bearing a brass-gray measuring caliper. The physical instrument suggests measurement without numbers, data plots or a software screen.
must_show: centered focal elements that survive cover cropping

candidate_notes.A: Viable alternate. Separate specimen and instrument are clear, but scenery and lateral instrument placement weaken the focal relationship.
candidate_notes.B: Viable alternate. Strong material detail and open gap; the abstract specimen is less immediately recognizable.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. The recognizable terracotta specimen and unmarked measuring caliper stay separate across an open gap, supporting the distinction between an observed outcome and its measurement. No measured result is invented.

crop_review.article_desktop: 1200 x 430 center-cover crop inspected: the central metaphor remains readable.
crop_review.article_mobile: 359 x 240 center-cover crop inspected: focal objects remain distinct.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 x 164 center-cover crop inspected: color and silhouette convey the same idea.
crop_review.home_square: 320 x 320 center-cover crop inspected: central focal elements survive; nonessential peripheral context is cropped.

golden_reference_comparison: The specimen and caliper retain the plugin ecosystem and Copilot review-control references' warm paper, stone, charcoal, terracotta and substantial physical forms. This still life is sparser than their mechanical architecture; Golden Reference Fit is 88. It would look intentionally commissioned for the same publication without metadata.
